entities.summary: George Ernest Wright, was a leading Old Testament scholar and biblical archaeologist. An expert in Ancient Near Eastern archaeology, he was especially known for his work in the study and dating of pottery. He was associated with the biblical theology movement. G. Ernest Wright was a architects & engineers from Ohio (1909-09-05, Ohio–1974-08-29). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
